entries.root_cause: Metric-definition completion validated gross runtime payload shape and completion coherence before resolving a legitimately running claim. NULL, non-array, over-bound or incoherent completion input could therefore raise at the persistence boundary before a durable terminal outcome was written, allowing malformed provider/runtime input to own operation liveness and leave claimed work indefinitely running.
horizontal_audit: all completion entry points that accept provider-controlled or deserialized payloads after work is claimed
claim resolution ordering relative to runtime type, shape and cardinality validation
terminalization behavior for NULL, wrong-type, over-bound and incoherent completion inputs
degraded evidence identity when caller-provided snapshot identifiers are absent or collide
helper function EXECUTE privileges after wrapping an older completion implementation
PostgreSQL harness stdin paths to ensure adversarial payloads are actually executed
future metric current/history/problem completion paths with claimed work and provider-controlled payloads
